args.question:
Borealis Freight has two invoices currently in "approved" status:

1. INV-89077 — $6,848.41, due 2026-11-04
2. INV-66306 — $5,488.58, due 2026-11-25

Which invoice should I pay by wire from the operating account? (I'll use ACH if wire is unavailable.)
